_comment: Tier-2 for febio::linear_elasticity#2. Pins 'Component "" needs to have property "solver" defined' for a <Control> with no nested <solver>, INCLUDING the empty component name, and separates it from the neighbouring mistake: <solver type="biphasic"/> inside a solid module gives 'invalid value for attribute "type"' and never the missing-property message. The positive control — the same deck with only the one wrong thing put right — is what makes the observed message attributable to the trigger rather than to anything else in the deck. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 gives the "no solver" slot the COMPLETE <Control> block, nested <solver type="solid"/> included. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'control_no_solver=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
